messages:
adrienne: Quick heads-up — starting onboarding for llama3-slim v1. Weights: gs://redwood-weights/onboard/llama3-slim/v1. Tokenizer mapping changes: introduced <|role|> sentinel and BOS now treated as empty string; chat templates tweaked. CI is failing format-delta tests on prompt formatting. Can someone triage? :eyes:

matt: On it. can you paste the failing diff?

adrienne: Here's the small excerpt from unit runner:
```
AssertionError: prompt mismatch
Expected: "<|role|>user: Hello\n"
Actual: "user: Hello\n"
```
looks like sentinel not injected in serialization.

siva: Huh. Is this the new tokenizer build? Which tokenizer binary path did you point to?

adrienne: using gs://redwood-weights/onboard/llama3-slim/v1/tokenizer/tokenizer.json and config at gs://redwood-weights/onboard/llama3-slim/v1/config.yaml

matt: Quick config check — if config.chat.template starts with `{{role}}` it assumes sentinel exists. If tokenizer.serialized_specials doesn't include `<|role|>` the serializer strips it. paste config?

adrienne: paste config snippet
```
chat:
  template: "{{role}}: {{content}}\n"
tokenizer:
  special_tokens: ["<|sep|>"]
  bos_token: ""
  eos_token: ""
```

lena: aha — special_tokens missing `<|role|>`. Add it and rerun. Also ensure lexicon maps the sentinel to a stable id (non-colliding).

adrienne: adding now. quick heads-up: will this affect cache/key for prefix caching in infra? we changed actual token ids.

siva: yes, it will bump cache keys. if ids change we need a rollout that flushes KV cache for this model. I'd prefer canary with zero-downtime fallback to previous model id mapping.

adrienne: noted. opened gh issue #3421 for rollout plan. tagging @matt for code review on serialization change.

matt: review pinged. small fix + unit to cover sentinel injection.

ci-bot: format-delta-tests — 1 failed, rerun queued by @matt

adrienne: thanks — will wait for CI then coordinate Dedicated rollout. If CI green, plan: canary 10% for 2 hours then 50%.

lena: team FYI — update ops docs with tokenizer special token list. small PR please.

siva: reminder to add migration note for cache keys in release notes.

adrienne: thanks all :pray:
